# TiTEC Automation

> TiTEC Automation is a leading industrial automation solutions provider in Sri Lanka,
> offering PLC programming, SCADA systems, electrical design, robotic integration,
> and a full catalog of industrial automation products.

## About
- Company: TiTEC Automation (Pvt) Ltd
- Location: Sri Lanka
- Industry: Industrial Automation & Control Systems
- Website: https://www.titecautomation.lk

## What We Offer
- Industrial automation product catalog (PLCs, HMIs, VFDs, sensors, control panel components)
- PLC programming and integration services
- SCADA system design and implementation
- Electrical panel design and wiring
- Robotic arm programming (Kawasaki, KUKA, Borunte)
- Industrial IoT solutions
- Quotation request system for bulk/custom orders
